# pai rules

Security rules: list them, lint their fixtures

```
pai rules <command>
```

The PreToolUse security rules. Built-ins ship with the package; user rules live in PAI_HOME/rules or .pai/rules as *.rule.yaml files — a user rule with a built-in's id replaces it, severity: off disables it.

```sh
pai rules list
pai rules lint
```

See also: `pai audit tokens hooks`

### pai rules list

Every rule with severity, source and enabled state

```
pai rules list [options]
```

One row per rule id; a disabled (severity: off) rule shows as off.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Machine-readable JSON output |

```sh
pai rules list
pai rules list --json
```

### pai rules lint

Run every rule's fixtures; exit 1 on a failure or load error

```
pai rules lint [options]
```

Each rule's tests.match strings must hit and tests.no_match strings must not. Load errors count as failures.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Machine-readable JSON output |

```sh
pai rules lint
pai rules lint --json
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
